messages:
Priya: night handoff from me — quick summary of where things stand

Priya: incidents: 1) embedding-service increased 5xx rate around 03:12 UTC, ~4% of requests. 2) small SQS backlog for dedupe-worker, not blocking but visible.

Priya: mitigations in-flight: rolled embedding v2 -> v2-fallback in route for 20% of traffic, added circuit breaker to return cached embeddings when kv-read latency > 200ms. Patched a hotfix to drop an expensive feature flag in embed path.

Marco: saw the 5xx spikes on metrics, looks correlated with a recent kernel bump on the gpu pool? I put a note on the cluster ticket. Any logs for the exact error?

Priya: logs show `nv_inference: cudnn failed to allocate workspace` intermixed with `OOME-alloc` on the host. Failures mostly on jobs > 1024 tokens.

Jen: pushed a quick autoscaler tweak to avoid packing >2 large-model pods on same host, that should reduce concurrent memory pressure. Also added a fallback to a smaller quantized variant for requests hitting 5xx.

Sam: for the SQS backlog — I drained 80% with a temporary scale-up of dedupe-workers (kbatch=+3). I left autoscaler at manual so it doesn't oscillate. Need someone to revert in the morning once backlog <100.

Priya: next steps for the handoff:
- monitor embed 5xx rate and host OOM logs for next 2h;
- if 5xx > 2% for 30m, promote v2-fallback to 50% and open an incident channel;
- Sam to revert dedupe-worker scale once backlog <100;
- Marco to follow up on kernel bump + notify infra if we see hardware-level OOMs.

Marco: ack, I'll check node-level OOM traces and link the cluster ticket here. If it's kernel-related we may need a rollback window.

Jen: left a short runbook note on the embed playbook: commands to check quick stats:

```
# check embeddings 5xx rate
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=embed-router | grep "5xx" | tail -n 200
# check host OOMs
gcloud compute ssh node-123 -- dmesg | grep -i oom
```

Jen: also added a dashboard alert rule to page at 5xx>3% sustained 15m.

ops-bot: deploy finished: embed-router v2-fallback @ 1893456820 — rollout to 20%

Priya: handoff notes: I'm available by DM until 04:30 UTC if anything spikes. Otherwise tagging the morning oncall to pick up checks at 06:00 UTC.

Sam: I'll watch the dedupe backlog for the next hour and ping when reverted.

Marco: linking ticket here: https://rwd.infra/ticket/INC-7842 — adding logs and node traces.

Priya: thanks team — leaving notes in the incident doc, passing to Marco for incident follow-up. :wave:
